summary: PASS. No Blocker. The Phase 3 script change (the Lily bangs guard now reads the column span of the two eye components over rows r0 to the higher eye top) behaves exactly as the spec of acb3afbb states: it does not refuse the real Lily, it still refuses hair above the eyes and on the nose bridge, and hair that touches an eye is refused by the two-component rule; alpha 250 and Chebyshev 40 hold at their edges. The chin and side-chin guards pass the real chin-length bob with a 30 to 59 px colour margin to the mouth and freckles. The child tools reproduce the real Tom and Lily records exactly (rows equal TABLES.child, palms ok, base and hashes equal the files), the adult records and Mom's hashes are unchanged, the eleven test files pass 119 of 119, and F3, F7, F18, F19 and F6 hold on the real five with Tom and Lily writing panels and no crop. Three findings for measure/tech-debt.md: P3-F1 (Major: the guards read the declared first hair option, so a reorder of variants.hair makes them blind with exit 0), P3-F2 (Nit: the spec sentence about hair over an eye names the wrong line) and P3-F3 (Nit: the rectangle edges are not pinned by a test).
nonblocking_findings: P3-F1 [Major] adversarial-testing: the Lily guards read the DECLARED first hair option, not the hair colour that the render holds, and nothing ties the two. assets/sprout-lily-kim.ts holds the colour twice: C.hair '#7a5230' paints the hair (line 36, used at line 190) and variants.hair lists brown, dark, blonde (line 316). scripts/proportion-check.mjs reads Object.values(variants.hair)[0]. tests/sprout-lily-kim.test.ts:100-102 pins only that the first option is a hex string. Probes on the real Lily outputs with an override asset: with 'dark' (#4a2e1c) first, hair painted across the chin band exits 0 with no guard (the painted #7a5230 is 48 from the declared colour), while with the real order the same paint gives 'GUARD lily chin: hair crosses the chin at row 366'; with 'blonde' (#b07f3a) first the unmodified real Lily is refused ('GUARD lily chin ... row 324'); a malformed first option ('red') makes all three Lily guards blind with exit 0. The real asset is consistent today, so no real input fails; a one-line reorder of the variants gives a false pass that no test catches. Fix: after reading the hair colour, require that the flat front render holds at least a stated share of head-row pixels within 40 of it (for example 1000 px) and that it matches /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i, else exit 1 with 'hair colour: not in the render'; and pin in tests/sprout-lily-kim.test.ts that the first option equals the painted hair colour.

P3-F2 [Nit] adversarial-testing: the spec sentence added in acb3afbb ('Hair over an eye, or over the nose bridge between the eyes, still fails this line') is not what the code does. Hair over or touching an eye fails a different line: a strip over both eyes gives 'eye components: found 1, expected 2', and a strip, a fringe over one eye or a fringe over an eye's upper third gives 'eye component touches the window' (probes C1, C2, C4, C6b); none prints the bangs line. Hair on the nose bridge is read only above the higher eye top: the guard fires for a pixel at rows 228 to 236 and for a strand that starts above the eyes, but a pixel at row 237 and a 3 by 3 blob at rows 240 to 242 on the bridge exit 0. A real bob cannot make an isolated blob there, so no real input is affected. Fix: reword the spec to 'hair above the higher eye top inside the eye column span fails this line; hair that touches an eye fails the two-component rule'.

P3-F3 [Nit] adversarial-testing: no test pins the edges of the changed rectangle. tests/proportion-cast-options.test.ts holds one bangs fixture (hair at x 504 to 520, inside the span) and the real-Lily pin would catch a return to the whole head width, but a change of the span by a few pixels or of the rows by one is not caught. The probes give the expected edges on the real Lily: rows 228 (r0, fires) and 227 (does not) to 236 (fires) and 237 (does not); columns 439 (x0, fires), 438 (does not), 585 (x1, fires), 586 (does not); alpha 250 fires and 249 does not; Chebyshev 40 fires and 41 does not on each channel. Fix: add Red cases for x0-1, x0, x1, x1+1 and for the rows r0-1, r0, eyeTop-1, eyeTop on a synthetic Lily figure, at alpha 250 and 249.
evidence: Scope: git diff aed0bcc0c3562de1def0242a29d35dd3dca31b68 HEAD -- scripts/ changes only scripts/proportion-check.mjs, 10 lines in the Lily bangs block (lines 737-753): the loop reads the columns from the smaller x0 to the larger x1 of the two eye components, not c0 to c1 (the head width), over the rows r0 to eyeTop - 1. scripts/sprout-cast-panel.mjs has an empty diff. The spec of acb3afbb states the rule as built (rows r0 up to but not including the higher y0, columns x0 to x1 both included, hair alpha 250 or more, Chebyshev 40).

Real geometry of the changed guard on the real Lily flat front (instrumented scratch copy): window top r0 228, higher eye top 237, eye components x 439 to 484 and 539 to 585. The rectangle is 9 rows by 147 columns (1323 px); the old one was 323 columns (2907 px) and held 849 temple-hair pixels. The new rectangle holds only skin (#f2c7a4) and eye white (#f8f2e9). The real Lily passes with no guard, so the change does not falsely refuse her (probe C0, exit 0).

Real violations still refused (hair colour painted on the real Lily flat front, measured by the real script): hair on the nose bridge (rows 228-236) gives 'GUARD lily bangs'; one hair pixel at the bridge, at the span edge x0 and x1, and at row r0 each give it; hair over one eye, over both eyes, over the upper half of both eyes and over the upper third of one eye each fail ('eye components: found 1' or 'eye component touches the window'). Alpha 250 and 251 and 255 are hair, alpha 249 and 128 are not (spec); colour distance 40 is hair and 41 is not on the R, G and B channels. A fringe above the window (rows 150-227), a pixel one column outside the span and a temple pixel 30 px outside pass, as the spec allows. Tom with the same strip exits 0 (the guards run for sprout-lily-kim only).

Library cases (synthetic Lily figure): a missing second eye gives 'eye components: found 1, expected 2' and the Lily guards do not run; hair above the left eye, above the bridge, at the span edges x0 and x1 gives the bangs line; one pixel outside the span at either end, and alpha 249, give none.

Chin and side-chin guards on the real Lily (flat renders): the chin band (rows 324 to 371, face columns) holds no colour within 40 of #7a5230; the nearest colours are freckles #b5713f at 59 and the mouth blends at 70 or more (the nearest mouth-skin blend is 70.5), so the real mouth #c04040 keeps a 30 px margin. A dark mouth would cross the radius (skin-to-#6a3028, #5a2a2a and #8a3a30 blends come within 11, 15 and 20), which is the spec rule 6 reason. The real side render's frontmost chin pixels are skin (#f2c7a4, alpha 255 and 191, distance 0 to 2). Hair painted across the chin band gives 'GUARD lily chin ... row 366'; hair at the frontmost side chin pixels at alpha 255, 191 and 128 gives 'GUARD lily side chin'; a mouth-coloured frontmost pixel also gives it (named hair, by design); a skin pixel at alpha 191 gives none.

Child tools on the real Tom and Lily: a fresh run of the HEAD script with --base humanoid-kim-child --table child on the real outputs exits 0 and reproduces both real records exactly on asset, base, baseSha256, the five hashes, rows, detail, guards, palms, ppm and imageSize. The eleven rows equal TABLES.child in name, order, lo and hi, all in range (Tom 2.8963, 1.2318, 0.3352, 2.1338, -0.1241, 0.4306, 0.6472, 0.1410, 0.3103, 0.2289, 0.4925; Lily 2.8984, 1.2318, 0.3353, 2.1421, -0.1241, 0.4306, 0.6462, 0.1412, 0.3121, 0.2291, 0.4951), both palms ok, base 'humanoid-kim-child', baseSha256 equals the SHA-256 of assets/parts/humanoid-kim-child.ts, the GLB and render hashes equal the files, detail.chinRow 378.58 and 371.79 with headHeight 315.58 and 318.79 (chinRow minus projectedCrownRow).

Adult regression: fresh runs of the HEAD script on the real Dad, Grandma, Grandpa and Mom outputs reproduce their real records exactly (asset, base, hashes, rows, detail, guards, palms, ppm, faceMarks, handEdge, sideSign), both palms ok, no guard. Mom's eleven rows are unchanged and her five artifact hashes are 6f972378, 0c6201ae, 93bea38c, 2abd3f55 and 48fc3c2f (equal plan T0).
